Send a project's notifications to a Slack channel

## Usage

`circleci notification slack <command> [flags]`

## Available Commands

| Command  | Description                                          |
| -------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `delete` | Remove a project's Slack channel                     |
| `get`    | Show a project's Slack channel and Slack preferences |
| `set`    | Set, enable or disable a project's Slack channel     |

## Flags

Global flags: `-c, --config`, `--debug`, `--no-color`, `-q, --quiet` — see `circleci --help`.

## Details

The CircleCI Slack app must already be installed for the organization.
